declared_surfaces.label: DVWA blind SQLi id parameter (Submit=Submit fixed in URL)

notes: Surfaces transcribed from the completed bout (commit cf006da). Submit=Submit is a black-box fact: DVWA's low sqli_blind page only runs its query when the form submit param is present. Session: the runner runs the bootstrap fresh per pass and parses its 'cookie header:' line (PHPSESSID is per-boot, so it is never stored here); seeded_cookies pins the security level, and 'cookies' names the pair the bootstrap must produce.
